label: All ten skill-shaped controls keep their incumbent skill: sk-git x3, sk-doc x2, system-spec-kit, sk-prompt, sk-code, memory:save trio.
Controls contain generic verbs a careless doctor phrase set could collide with: set up a new git worktree and update the changelog, so doctor phrases must be multi-token and diagnostic.
run a deep review of this spec already returns system-deep-loop and sk-code tied at confidence 0.95 (0.8209 vs 0.8227), a baseline ambiguity any admission must not grow.

Eight candidate doctor phrases already route to the owning skill rather than a doctor diagnostic: four git-family phrases to sk-git, two sk-code surface phrases to sk-code, advisor wrong-skill to system-skill-advisor, and trigger index drift to system-spec-kit.
Three candidate phrases return empty today and carry zero theft risk as first-wave additions: disable comment hygiene gate, runtime mirror drift, skill budget audit.

Two candidate phrases mis-route today: new skill not appearing in advisor results to sk-doc, and Code Mode broken to mcp-code-mode plus sk-code, where the doctor diagnostics are the intended surfaces.
Verbatim duplication is the theft mechanism: a three-token doctor phrase scoring 1.0 would compete with the incumbent skill evidence as a tie or ambiguity rather than a clean handoff.
Incumbent diagnostic routes sit at 0.82-0.95 confidence, so admitted doctor phrases with 3+ tokens can be expected to clear the 0.8 gate.
Arbitration guards: phrase ownership, 3+ token diagnostic phrases, empty phrases first, post-admission control re-run with unchanged top skills, and zero new ambiguous pairs.
The 0.08 command demotion applies only to slashless prompts and is small relative to full-specificity phrases, so it cannot serve as the theft guard.
